It's been thawing since we got it out of the collector.|Kanna Deltic introduces Smiley to Firmus Piett|}} A [[mynock]], posthumously nicknamed '''Smiley''', lived inside the [[exogorth]] [[Sy-O]] inside one of the [[asteroid]]s of the [[Hoth asteroid field]]. In [[3 ABY]], it fed on the power cables of the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[YT-1300 light freighter|vessel]] landed within Sy-O's [[Mouth|maw]]. The [[Starship]]'s [[captain]], [[Han Solo]], then shot and [[Death|killed]] the mynock and its body was sucked out into [[Realspace|space]] when the ''Falcon'' exited through the exogorth's mouth. The mynock's body was then discovered by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Admiral]] [[Rae Sloane]] and [[Lieutenant]] [[Kanna Deltic]] while they were flying through the [[asteroid field]] in the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Bastinade]]''. The pair collected the mynocks body and brought it with them to the ''[[Executor]]'', [[Flagship]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. After Deltic analyzed the corpse and gave it its nickname, it was presented to [[Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett]] and Vader, with Sloane showing the [[blaster]] burn on Smiley's corpse as proof that the ''Falcon'' had been hidden in the asteroid field. ==Biography== {{Quote|Yeah, that's what I thought-mynock. Chewie, check the rest of the ship and make sure there are no more attached, chewing on the power cables.|Han Solo, after killing Smiley|{{Film|V}}}} A [[mynock]], which would be posthumously nicknamed Smiley, lived inside the [[exogorth]] [[Sy-O]]{{StoryCite|story=This Is No Cave|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}} in an [[asteroid]] in the [[Hoth asteroid field]]. In [[3 ABY]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[YT-1300 light freighter]] fleeing from the [[Galactic Empire]], flew into Sy-O's [[Mouth|maw]] and landed inside the exogorth in order to lay low. Smiley landed on the [[Starship|ship]] and began feeding on the power cables. After [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] spotted a mynock through the [[cockpit]] [[viewport]], the crew emerged to investigate. [[Captain]] [[Han Solo]] spotted the mynock opened fire with his [[Han's heavy blaster pistol|blaster pistol]] and [[Death|killed]] Smiley. When the ''Falcon'' then took off and flew out through Sy-O's mouth, Smiley's corpse was sucked out into [[Realspace|space]] along with several other mynocks. The other mynocks perished in the vacuum and the cluster of dead mynocks was later spotted by [[Admiral]] [[Rae Sloane]], who was flying through the [[asteroid field]] with [[Lieutenant]] [[Kanna Deltic]] in the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Bastinade]]''. The pair collected and froze the corpses of Smiley and several other mynocks and then flew to the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Executor]]''. While Sloane reported to [[Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett]] and the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], Deltic took the mynocks and analyzed them in the [[Star Destroyer]]'s labs. She discovered the [[blaster]] mark on Smiley's corpse and gave the creature its nickname, before being summoned to Sloane's side by Vader. Deltic brought the mynock with her on a [[Repulsorcart|hovercart]] under a tarp and then revealed it to Sloane and Piett. She explained the analysis had shown that Smiley was killed by a hand blaster, proving that the ''Falcon'' had been hidden within the asteroid field. Sloane later ordered a pair of [[stormtrooper]]s to remove the mynock's corpse. ==Personality and traits== Smiley was a massive mynock with [[Color|brown]] skin. ==Behind the scenes== Smiley first appeared in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. The creature was then identified in the short story "[[Lord Vader Will See You Now]]," which was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published in [[2020]] as part of the ''[[From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back]]'' anthology. ==Appearances== {{IncompleteList}} *{{Film|V}} {{1st}} *{{StoryCite|story=Lord Vader Will See You Now|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back|audiobook=1}} {{Corpse}} {{1stID|Smiley}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/scariest-star-wars-scenes|text=13 of the Scariest ''Star Wars'' Scenes}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Named creatures]]
